svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Main tube: 20 x 10 x 2 mm rectangular steel tube, 376 mm long, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front end closed by a 2 mm plate. Pivot boss: 20 x 10 mm flat bar,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 34 long, butt-welded to the back end; 12 mm pivot hole 10 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Up-arm: 20 x 10 mm bar, ends rounded, welded at the pivot end standing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square to the main bar; 10 mm hole 50 mm above the pivot hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grip: 28 mm tube 30 mm long, welded across the front end so it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands out to the left, away from the enclosure.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the bracket's pivot pin with an 11 mm spacer between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lever and the bracket. Wheels down: the lever lies forward,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: resting on the stop tab. Wheels up: the lever stands straight up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The link joins the up-arm to the crank pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lever swings a quarter turn without touching anything.
